ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ فِي الْأَوَّلِيْنَ ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ فِي الْأٓخِرِيْنَ ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ فِيْ كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَ حِيْنٍ ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى أٰلِهٖ فِي الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى جَمِيْعِ الْأَنْبِيَآءِ وَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ ،
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī fī ‘l-awwalīn, Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī fī ‘l-ākhirīn, Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī fī kulli waqtin wa ḥīn, Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī fī ‘l-mala’i ‘l-`a‘lā ilā Yawmi ‘d-Dīn. Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā jamī`i ‘l-Anbiyā’i wa ‘l-Mursalīn,
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family among the first, and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family among the last, and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family in every instant and interval, and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family in the Highest Assembly until the Day of Judgement. , and send prayers upon, salute and bless the entirety of Prophets and Messengers,
blocks.review: أٰلِهٖ (×4): hamza with a small stroke above and a vertical stroke hanging below, read as dagger alif + standing kasra; marks crowd the line below. الْأٓخِرِيْنَ: hamza and a displaced madda over the alif. فِي before الْ printed without sukūn.
